correctness.rationale: PASS: Evaluating the identity on (c,e),(c,f) forces R(c)=xc even in characteristic two because fields contain no nonzero square-zero elements. The (e,f) relation becomes (y-x)z=xy-lambda x+uv with free alpha,beta. Separating y=x and y!=x gives q^6 and q^6+q^4 counts. det R=x^2(y+z-lambda); counting zero uv fibers in x!=0, y+z!=lambda yields the claimed invertible formulas and handles q=2 correctly. Fresh independent exhaustive evaluation of the Rota–Baxter identity on all 2^9 and 3^9 linear maps (both lambda=0,1) gave (64,8),(80,16),(729,270),(810,297), matching total and invertible counts.

The direct fiber count is independent arithmetic work rather than a verbatim or proven numerical corollary printed in those complex-field classifications; an earlier finite-field enumeration remains a risk.
